scripts.e2e:install: node scripts/env.mjs npx playwright install --only-shell chromium webkit
scripts.e2e: node scripts/env.mjs npm run e2e -w @moonveil/e2e -- --project desktop-chromium --project mobile-chromium --project mobile-webkit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run e2e
scripts.e2e:scale: node scripts/env.mjs npm run e2e -w @moonveil/e2e -- scale --project desktop-chromium
scripts.e2e:matches: E2E_TIME_SCALE=${E2E_TIME_SCALE:-10} node scripts/env.mjs npm run e2e -w @moonveil/e2e -- --project real-matches
scripts.e2e:matches:voice: E2E_VOICE=1 E2E_TIME_SCALE=${E2E_TIME_SCALE:-10} node scripts/env.mjs npm run e2e -w @moonveil/e2e -- --project real-matches
scripts.e2e:ui: E2E_TIME_SCALE=${E2E_TIME_SCALE:-10} node scripts/env.mjs npm run e2e -w @moonveil/e2e -- --project ui-laptop --project ui-phone-chromium --project ui-phone-webkit
scripts.e2e:ui:accept: E2E_UI_STRICT=1 E2E_TIME_SCALE=${E2E_TIME_SCALE:-5} node scripts/env.mjs npm run e2e -w @moonveil/e2e -- --project ui-laptop --project ui-phone-chromium && E2E_UI_STRICT=1 E2E_TIME_SCALE=${E2E_WEBKIT_TIME_SCALE:-2} node scripts/env.mjs npm run e2e -w @moonveil/e2e -- --project ui-phone-webkit
